purpose: Teach: 差益/守秘/ターボ/コストダウン/返上/行革/株券/引渡し

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、為替差益詐欺の捜査も進めてらっしゃるんですね
lines.en: So the police are also investigating forex fraud cases.
lines.style: Conversational acknowledgment with genuine curiosity. Warm, attentive. Light uplift on the observation, as if impressed by the scope of their work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、内部情報の守秘を厳格にされてますね
lines.en: The police keep information confidentiality very strict, I've noticed.
lines.style: Thoughtful, approving tone. Measured pacing. Slight nod in the voice—recognizing competence without overstepping.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、緊急車両のターボ性能を活かされますね
lines.en: I see the police really make use of those emergency vehicles' performance capabilities.
lines.style: Observant, mildly admiring. Soft conversational tone, not flattering. Curious about practical details.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、捜査資源のコストダウンも工夫されてますね
lines.en: You folks have found some clever ways to keep investigation costs down too.
lines.style: Genuine appreciation, slightly conspiratorial. Recognizing effort without presuming to know everything. Warm, collegial.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、汚職警官の階級返上を進められましたね
lines.en: That was important work, getting corrupt officers to return their ranks.
lines.style: Sincere, steady. Quiet conviction. Respectful of the difficulty. No performative praise, just clear acknowledgment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内の行革にも取り組まれてますね
lines.en: Administrative reform at the station level—that takes real commitment.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured. Understands the complexity. Warm but not overstating. Genuine recognition of the work involved.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、株券偽造の捜査もご担当ですね
lines.en: Share certificate forgery investigations fall under your purview too, then.
lines.style: Calm, factual observation. Conversational, following the thread of the discussion naturally. Slight uptick showing engagement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、犯罪収益の引渡しを連邦に進められますね
lines.en: And moving criminal proceeds to federal agencies—that's a significant hand-off.
lines.style: Firmer, more serious. Slight shift in tone recognizing the weight of that work. Steady, respectful. The last line landing with quiet importance.
